grenades.description: Explosive devices thrown or launched to deliver area-of-effect damage, perfect for disrupting groups or flushing out enemies from cover.

items.name: Grenade
properties: 4d4 Blunt + 4d4 Pierce Damage at the end of the next Turn

items.name: Acid Grenade
properties: 5d4 Corrosion Damage and Inflicts Weakened at the end of the next Turn

items.name: Corruption Grenade
properties: At the end of the next Turn, Area is Corrupted for 2d4 Turns (Apply ‘Vulnerable All’ condition to creatures in the area)

items.name: Flash Grenade
properties: 5d4 Brilliant damage at the end of the next Turn

items.name: Fire Grenade
properties: At the end of the next Turn, Area is ablaze for 2d4 Turns (Any creature that starts its Turn in, enters, or moves within the area takes 5d4 Burn damage)

items.name: Frost Grenade
properties: 5d4 Frost damage and Inflicts Slowed at the end of the next Turn

items.name: Plasma Grenade
properties: 10d4 Pure damage at the end of the next Turn

items.name: Shock Grenade
properties: 5d4 Shock damage and Inflicts Staggered at the end of the next Turn

items.name: Sleep Grenade
properties: Inflicts Asleep at the end of the next Turn

items.name: Smoke Grenade
properties: At the end of the next Turn, Area is obscured for 2d4 Turns (Any creature within the area gains Greater Cover but is also considered Blinded while inside the area)

items.name: Stench Grenade
properties: At the end of the next Turn, Area is stenched for 2d4 Turns (Any creature that starts its Turn in, enters, or moves within the area are Dazed and Dizzied)

items.name: Toxic Grenade
properties: 5d4 Toxic damage and Inflicts Fatigued at the end of the next Turn

items.name: Web Grenade
properties: At the end of the next Turn, All creatures in the area are Restrained and Immobilised

snares.description: Concealed traps designed to immobilize or hinder foes, ideal for controlling the battlefield or setting up ambushes.

items.name: Explosive Clay
properties: Combine this with an explosive you possess and it becomes a trap

items.name: Grease
properties: Instant Knocked Down until they escape the area

items.name: Perimeter Alarm
properties: Loud acoustic alarm when triggered, alerts all allies within 100m

items.name: Motion Sensor
properties: Silent alert to user's communicator when triggered, detects movement within 5m radius

items.name: Lure
properties: Blinking lights and sound to attract enemies, draws enemies toward the device location

items.name: Net
properties: Instant Immobilized and Prone until they escape (Strength vs Risk 8)

items.name: Bear Trap
properties: Instant Immobilized and Bleeding, target must spend 5 Stamina per Turn to attempt escape (Strength vs Risk 8)

items.name: Pitfall
properties: Instant 5d6 Pierce damage and Prone, requires 10 minutes and tools to dig

items.name: Decoy
properties: False target that appears valuable, enemies must pass Intellect vs Risk 7 to recognize as fake, draws enemy attention and movement
